nonzero_issues.explanation: At least one age needed to assess change is missing.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Do not fill ages using other-wave age minus three; retain applicant and other outcomes.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Follow-up age is lower than baseline age; both reports cannot be chronologically correct.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Preserve raw values; flag both reports as unresolved; keep unrelated outcomes; sensitivity may omit these applicants.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Age unchanged despite described approximately three-year follow-up.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Flag timing discrepancy, not a proven typo; retain records and avoid adjusting for follow-up age.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Age change outside a deliberately broad diagnostic interval around three years; exact dates unavailable.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Keep in main sample; show cohort distribution and sensitivity; do not force every age gap to three.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Highest grade completed conflicts with completion indicator for grade 6.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Source of error cannot be identified. Preserve reported outcomes; use separate sensitivity excluding contradictory grade records.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Highest grade completed conflicts with completion indicator for grade 7.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Source of error cannot be identified. Preserve reported outcomes; use separate sensitivity excluding contradictory grade records.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Highest grade completed conflicts with completion indicator for grade 8.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Source of error cannot be identified. Preserve reported outcomes; use separate sensitivity excluding contradictory grade records.

nonzero_issues.explanation: At least one grade completion indicator disagrees with highest grade.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: No automatic overwrite of one measurement with another; analyze grade robustness on records without contradictions.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent age is no greater than applicant age.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Set this parent-age cell to missing only in an explicitly cleaned derivative; retain applicant and other fields.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent-child age gap is positive but below 12 years.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Flag as implausible for review; do not assume exact correction or remove applicant.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent-child age gap is greater than 60 years; unusual value, not necessarily impossible.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Flag for review; preserve without an externally supported correction.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent age is no greater than applicant age.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Set this parent-age cell to missing only in an explicitly cleaned derivative; retain applicant and other fields.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent-child age gap is positive but below 12 years.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Flag as implausible for review; do not assume exact correction or remove applicant.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Reported parent-child age gap is greater than 60 years; unusual value, not necessarily impossible.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Flag for review; preserve without an externally supported correction.

nonzero_issues.explanation: No current paid work is reported together with positive hours worked per week.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Retain raw reports; treat as unresolved definition/reporting conflict; check secondary work results excluding this record.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Paid work is reported with zero weekly hours; this can occur with temporary absence or distinct reference periods.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Retain valid zero; flag for clarification. Do not replace zero hours with missing solely on this basis.

nonzero_issues.explanation: Five or six completed school years since allocation appear long for a described approximately three-year follow-up.
nonzero_issues.recommended_treatment: Retain and flag timing/definition ambiguity; do not use as a primary attainment outcome without clarification.
